requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Bottles with High Page Yield
requirements.Description: Develop NGB keyed ink bottles with 6,000-page yield for Black and CMY, with CMY bottle size supporting over 8,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Higher page yields reduce customer intervention and lower total cost of ownership, supporting competitive differentiation.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires compatibility with existing and new printer platforms.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Bottles must deliver at least 6,000 pages for Black and CMY, and CMY bottle size must exceed 8,000 pages as validated by ISO testing.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Reliability for Bottles
requirements.Description: Design ink bottles and system to ensure spill-free reliability during user handling and refilling.
requirements.Rationale: Minimizes mess and waste, improving customer satisfaction and reducing service costs.
requirements.Dependencies: Depends on bottle design and printer ink tank interface.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: No ink spillage occurs during standard refill process in usability and reliability testing.

requirements.Title: NOA-F with Metal Foiled Labyrinth and Lid Label
requirements.Description: Implement NOA-F (Non-Original Accessory-Filter) with a metal foiled labyrinth and lid label, with no changes to click-on push-push and TDF mechanisms.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances security, anti-counterfeit, and operational reliability.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires integration with current NOA-F and push-push mechanisms.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F must pass security validation and function seamlessly with existing mechanisms.

requirements.Title: Support for Customer Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: Enable customer replacement of Print Head Assembly (PHA) and NOA-F parts to enhance serviceability.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces downtime and service costs, improves user experience.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires modular hardware design and user instructions.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Customers can replace PHA and NOA-F without tools, as verified by usability studies.

requirements.Title: New Warranty Page Life Goal of 80k Pages
requirements.Description: Design product to support a new warranty page life goal of 80,000 pages per device.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with competitive benchmarks and reduces total cost of ownership for customers.
requirements.Dependencies: Impacts parts durability and consumables yield.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Device passes accelerated life tests simulating 80,000 printed pages without major failure.

requirements.Title: Size Optimization for Larger Tank
requirements.Description: Increase tank size to support higher ink capacity, with associated changes to input and output trays to accommodate tank protrusion.
requirements.Rationale: Supports higher page yield and reduces refill frequency.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires redesign of trays and enclosure.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer footprint remains within specified dimensions while supporting larger tank and functional trays.

requirements.Title: 4.3” CGD Touchscreen Interface
requirements.Description: Integrate a 4.3-inch color graphical display (CGD) touchscreen for improved user interface.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances usability and supports advanced features.
requirements.Stakeholders: End Users, UX/UI Team, Product Management
requirements.Dependencies: Requires updated firmware and hardware.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All key functions accessible via the 4.3” touchscreen, validated by usability testing.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management
requirements.Description: Implement aerosol management in the service station with platform changes due to larger tank.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents ink aerosol contamination and maintains print quality and reliability.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires changes to service station design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Aerosol levels remain within acceptable limits during maintenance cycles.

requirements.Title: Paper Path for Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Redesign paper path components to support increased page life target of 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures durability and reliability over the extended warranty period.
requirements.Dependencies: Impacts material selection and mechanical design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paper path components pass durability testing for 80,000 pages without failure.

requirements.Title: Ink Maintenance as Serviceable Part Post-80k Life
requirements.Description: Design ink maintenance components to be serviceable after 80,000-page life, available at service centers.
requirements.Rationale: Extends device life beyond warranty and reduces e-waste.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires modular design and availability of service parts.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Service centers can replace ink maintenance parts post-warranty, as validated by service documentation.

requirements.Title: New IDS Make-break and FI Connection
requirements.Description: Develop new IDS (Ink Delivery System) make-break and fluidic interconnect (FI) connection with increased size, keying, and LOI (Level of Ink) One SHAID.
requirements.Rationale: Supports new tank design and ensures secure, reliable ink delivery.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires compatibility with new tank and bottle designs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: IDS connections pass leak and connectivity tests for all supported configurations.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Implement a new IDS startup algorithm and air management system for optimized priming and reliability.
requirements.Rationale: Improves first-time setup experience and reduces startup failures.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires firmware and IDS hardware updates.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Startup algorithm completes successfully in 99% of new device installations.

requirements.Title: New Print Quality (PQ) Goals and Depletion Metrics
requirements.Description: Define and implement new print quality (PQ) goals and depletion metrics to align with page yield definition.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures consistent output and aligns with marketing claims.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires test protocol updates.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Print quality and depletion meet or exceed defined metrics in 95% of test runs.

requirements.Title: EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel Compliance for PDL SKU
requirements.Description: Ensure product compliance with EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel environmental standards for PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: Supports environmental sustainability goals and required certifications for market access.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires documentation and design alignment to standards.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product passes third-party certification for EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel.

requirements.Title: EPS Foam Packaging
requirements.Description: Use EPS foam for product packaging to improve protection during shipping.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces damage during transit and supports logistics requirements.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires packaging design update.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product passes drop and vibration tests with EPS foam packaging.

requirements.Title: Support for SMB, Consumer, and Enterprise Services
requirements.Description: Provide solutions and business models for Consumer, SMB, and Enterprise, including PaaS and WorkFromHome/Flexworker options.
requirements.Rationale: Expands market reach and offers flexible service models.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires integration with HPX, HP One, SMB Portal, and ECP.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Service options are available and functional for all target segments at launch.

requirements.Title: Scan Solution and SMB Manageability
requirements.Description: Integrate scan solution and SMB manageability features, including support for WJA, HPSM, and JAM.
requirements.Rationale: Meets needs of SMB and enterprise customers for device management and workflow integration.
requirements.Stakeholders: Enterprise IT, SMB Customers, Product Management
requirements.Dependencies: Requires software and firmware integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Device supports scan and management features as validated by functional testing.

requirements.Title: Support for HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, UFD Clients and Drivers
requirements.Description: Ensure compatibility with HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, and UFD clients and drivers for broad deployment.
requirements.Rationale: Supports diverse customer IT environments and simplifies deployment.
requirements.Stakeholders: IT Administrators, End Users, Product Management
requirements.Dependencies: Requires driver and client software updates.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Device installs and operates with all listed clients and drivers in supported OS environments.

requirements.Title: Leverage Sayan Sibstar Tubes with New Routing
requirements.Description: Utilize Sayan Sibstar tubes for ink delivery, with new routing and integration for the 4-tube platform.
requirements.Rationale: Improves ink delivery reliability and supports new tank design.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires mechanical and routing design updates.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink delivery system operates without leaks or flow interruptions in all test scenarios.

requirements.Title: Factory Configuration for NOA-F, Magi and Nessie Ink Cart, and Labelling Tool
requirements.Description: Modify existing factory line SA14 for NOA-F, add Magi ink cart and labelling tool in Orcus 5, and provide mold for 1 to 4 new keyed caps.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures efficient manufacturing and supports new product features.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires factory process updates and tooling investments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Factory lines are updated and validated for new production requirements before mass production.

requirements.Title: Support for SuperAmp PHA, Magi, and Nessie Pigment Inks
requirements.Description: Ensure product supports SuperAmp PHA, Magi, and Nessie pigment inks with new 140ml K bottles and new CMY bottles.
requirements.Rationale: Maintains ink compatibility and supports high yield requirements.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires ink system and firmware compatibility.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Device operates reliably with all specified inks and bottle sizes.

requirements.Title: Reuse Marconi Hi PDL and Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, Raccoon PSU
requirements.Description: Leverage existing Marconi Hi PDL, Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, and Raccoon PSU components for cost and time savings.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces development cost and time by reusing proven components.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires compatibility validation with new design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All reused components pass functional and integration testing in new product.

requirements.Title: Stingray Wi-Fi Module Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate Stingray Wi-Fi module for wireless connectivity.
requirements.Rationale: Supports modern connectivity requirements for all customer segments.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires hardware and firmware integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Device connects to Wi-Fi networks using Stingray module in all supported regions.

requirements.Title: Firmware (FW) Dune Platform
requirements.Description: Utilize Dune firmware platform for device operation and feature support.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures consistent firmware experience and supports new hardware features.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires firmware customization and validation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Device operates reliably with Dune firmware and supports all required features.

requirements.Title: Gauss4.xx Security for Hardware and Firmware
requirements.Description: Implement Gauss4.xx security features for both hardware and firmware.
requirements.Rationale: Protects against unauthorized access and enhances device security posture.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires security validation and integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Device passes HP security certification for Gauss4.xx features.

requirements.Title: Schedule Adherence (Q3'25-Q4'27)
requirements.Description: Meet program schedule with key checkpoints from Q3'25 to Q4'27 as detailed in project plan.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures timely market entry and aligns with business objectives.
requirements.Dependencies: All development and validation activities must align to schedule.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All program milestones are completed on or before scheduled dates.

requirements.Title: SuperAmp PHA Life at 65K Pages (Constraint)
requirements.Description: Design SuperAmp PHA to support a life of 65,000 pages as a fixed constraint.
requirements.Rationale: Sets a boundary for PHA durability and impacts service strategy.
requirements.Dependencies: Impacts warranty and service parts planning.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp PHA passes durability tests for 65,000 pages in accelerated testing.

requirements.Title: Warranty Life of 2 Years or Page Target
requirements.Description: Product warranty to cover 2 years or the specified page life, whichever comes first.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with industry norms and customer expectations.
requirements.Dependencies: Impacts reliability and service parts planning.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty documentation clearly states coverage terms and is validated by legal and service teams.

requirements.Title: Throughput: 25/20 ppm (PDL: 25/19 ppm)
requirements.Description: Printer must achieve a throughput of 25/20 pages per minute (ppm), with PDL variant achieving 25/19 ppm.
requirements.Rationale: Meets competitive benchmarks for speed.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires hardware and firmware optimization.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Device achieves specified throughput in ISO speed tests.

requirements.Title: Serviceability: Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Ensure printer includes a serviceable maintenance box for ink waste and maintenance cycles.
requirements.Rationale: Improves uptime and reduces service intervention frequency.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires modular design for easy replacement.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box can be replaced by service personnel within 10 minutes as validated by service testing.
